item.title: IPNbase - a new resource released!
item.description:
The IPNbase database is released now. Welcome to visit, test, and provide feedback. Contacted by Xianqing.

Integrative Plant Nutrition (IPN) is based on the premise that plant nutrition should be understood not as a collection of isolated nutrient pathways, but as an interconnected system operating across biological scales and environmental contexts.
